text.description_html:
30 Inch Deco Style Solid Cast Bronze Appliance Pull

30 Inch Art Deco Style pull for your refrigerator or other appliance, cast in solid bronze with high quality craftsmanship. This stunning pull features ripples edges and a slightly widening pull that grants it the vintage aesthetic that is so popular. The Hamilton AP-113.30 pull is packaged standard for Thrubolt Mounting for a Refrigerator/Appliance panel.

Large "vacuum" sealed doors such as the those found on Sub Zero refrigerators are recommended to have 18" or longer pulls installed to effectively pull open it.

Also Available: matching 15" Inch Deco Style Solid Cast Bronze Appliance Pull

Specifications of the Bronze Appliance Pull:

  • Finish: Bronze Patina
  • Length c.c.: 30"
  • Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Pull Diameter: 5/8"
  • Finish: Bronze Patina
  • Material: Solid Cast Bronze
  • Hamilton AP-113 Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
